## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and limitations are described; unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks were run and their actual results are recorded above.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a short, informative Unreleased entry when applicable, and affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] Changes and attachments contain no credentials, personal process data, raw command lines, private paths, window titles or real inventory dumps.
- [ ] Privacy, rule scope, process lifetime and privilege boundaries are preserved, or intentional changes are explained.
